name: Background Runtime Supervision
description: Supervise background tasks: agent executions, file indexing, sync operations, build watchers. Detect hangs, apply timeouts, restart or escalate.
purpose: Background work is visible and managed.
acceptanceCriteria: Every background task has a registered supervision record with timeout and retry policy
Supervisor heartbeat checks run at configurable interval
Tasks exceeding their timeout are terminated and the escalation policy is triggered
Supervisor publishes status events for each supervised task (running, completed, failed, timed-out)
Restart loops are bounded — exceeding max restarts escalates instead of retrying
Supervisor survivies individual task crashes without itself terminating
required_evidence: Supervision record registration with timeout and retry policy test
Heartbeat check at configurable interval test
Status event publishing test (running, completed, failed, timed-out)
Bounded restart loop test (max restarts escalates)
acceptance_gates: Every background task has a supervision record
Heartbeat checks run at configurable interval
rollback_strategy: Task termination is rollback — supervisor kills the task; no additional state to revert
recovery_strategy: Task restart with backoff; if max restarts exceeded, escalate and do not restart
escalation_policy: After max restarts for any task, escalate to user with task identity and error history
